entries.title: Archive build fills workspace disk
entries.root_cause: The archive integration build retains all uncompressed fixture generations in the runner workspace, exhausting the filesystem. Remove old fixture generations or increase available space.

entries.title: Workspace disk full again
entries.root_cause: The archive integration build retains all uncompressed fixture generations in the runner workspace, exhausting the filesystem. Remove old fixture generations or increase available space.
entries.differs_from_earlier: A larger fixture generation fills the workspace during a different Gradle task and on a different runner.

entries.title: Index ordering assertion fails
entries.root_cause: The index comparator orders revisions ascending instead of descending. Correct the comparator.

entries.title: Artifact release upload denied
entries.root_cause: The workflow token has read-only contents permission, so release upload is forbidden. Grant contents write permission to the release job.
